name: Talondeep Path
summary: Beneath the ridge, Talondeep Path links Ashenvale with the Stonetalon Mountains. Its quiet tunnel runs from the woods west of Mystral Lake to Windshear Crag.

sections.title: A Quiet Mountain Pass
sections.body:
Talondeep Path runs beneath the ridge between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. It joins the woods west of Mystral Lake to the northwestern reaches of Windshear Crag. Surface trails cross dangerous country, where predators and warring factions roam. The tunnel stays calm, with no hostile beasts or encampments.

Side pockets twist away from the passage, and crevices and natural alcoves break up the rock. Above ground, faint traces of an old road remain along the peaks. Travelers once crossed there before taking the route through the stone.

faq.q: Where does the Talondeep Path lead?
faq.answer: Talondeep Path links southwestern Ashenvale to the northeastern Stonetalon Mountains. Its northern entrance lies just west of Mystral Lake, and its southern mouth opens into northwestern Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Are there monsters or enemies inside the tunnel?
faq.answer: No hostile creatures live inside Talondeep Path. The cavern is peaceful, with neither hostile beasts nor friendly folk, leaving a safe passage through the mountain divide.

faq.q: What are the ruins above the cavern?
faq.answer: The ruins above Talondeep Path are remnants of an overgrown road along the mountain ridge. They suggest travelers once crossed the crags by a treacherous surface route before using the tunnel.

faq.q: Is Talondeep Path an Alliance or Horde tunnel?
faq.answer: Neither faction holds Talondeep Path. The unfortified tunnel is neutral wilderness, open to travelers of any allegiance moving between the contested forest and the mountains.

angles.text: The winding rock alcoves cut through the mountain range's deep stone foundation. They make Talondeep Path a natural landmark between mineral-rich Ashenvale and Stonetalon.
